To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MeDoc provides a full text based search engine for the retrieval of scientific documents.
the MeDoc system is a full text based, Internet based publication and reference system that supports searching, browsing, delivery, and storage of documents.

MeDoc provides a full text based search engine, that allows for searching in distributed databases, that offers a user-friendly interface for the user and that is able to bill for the use of documents.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following topics: full text retrieval and information extraction, distributed information systems, information filtering and delivery and the integration of electronic and paper-based documents.

the following questions: How to design a system that allows for full text search and browsing of documents, how to design an architecture for distributed, heterogeneous document servers, how to design a system for billable services, how to design and implement a user interface that supports the use of the service.

a system which supports the information exchange in a distributed, heterogeneous and international research community and which allows for searching, storing and delivering documents in a convenient way.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MeDoc project was a great success.
we have developed a system which allows for the publication of documents and their retrieval in a distributed and heterogeneous environment.
the MeDoc system is a successful example of the application of new information and communication technology to the field of information management.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MeDoc is a full text based document delivery service for computer scientists.
the MeDoc system is a prototype of an information retrieval system for the publication and reference service of computer science.
we have implemented a system for full text searching in heterogeneous, structured databases.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is feasible to implement a full text publication and reference service for computer science on a broad scale.
it is possible to provide a high quality, full text based service that allows for searching and browsing in a heterogeneous, distributed database.
a system like MeDoc can be realized without the necessity of an expensive and complex document management system.
